raw_html: [[Holy Burst#Holy Burst|Holy Burst]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Holy Burst#Holy Burst|Holy Burst]]:''' A holy weapon is imbued with holy power. This power makes the weapon good-aligned and thus bypasses the corresponding damage reduction. It deals an extra 2 to 12 points of damage against all of evil alignment and an extra 3 to 18 on a critical for weapons with a x2 critical multiplier, 4 to 24 for a x3 multiplier, and 5 to 30 for a x4 multiplier.
